contextCard.title: How the draft order works
contextCard.body: Teams that miss the playoffs pick in the draft in order of their record, so the weakest teams pick first. Late-season results can move a team up or down the order, which is why the race for the top pick matters as much as the race for the playoffs.

playoffPicture.note: Seeds 1 to 4 are the division leaders. 5 to 7 are wild cards. Only the No. 1 seed gets a first-round bye.

headlines.title: Embiid's season-high 37 leads 76ers past Nets
headlines.summary: Joel Embiid scored a season-high 37 and Jaylen Brown added 31 as Philadelphia beat Brooklyn 135–123. Julius Randle had 33 for the Nets, and Nolan Traore matched his career high with 23. The Sixers are 4–0 without LeBron James.
headlines.whyItMatters: The Sixers are 12–3 and first in the East, but Brown's hamstring strain now sidelines him against the Magic.

headlines.title: Magic beat Celtics 115–105 for fourth straight win
headlines.summary: Orlando rallied in the fourth quarter to beat Boston 115–105. Desmond Bane had 24 points and eight rebounds, and Franz Wagner added 21 points and nine assists. The Magic earned their first win in Boston since December 2022, and it was Boston's first home loss of the season.
headlines.whyItMatters: Orlando is 6–7 and eighth in the East, while Boston is still second at 11–3.
